messages:
Maria K.: quick microcopy question — the error banner shown after a failed deploy feels vague. current copy: "Deployment failed — Retry". does that clearly tell users what will happen when they click Retry?
Tyler S.: agree it's ambiguous. could be restarting the whole job, requeueing, or just re-sending the request. suggest making the CTA explicit: "Retry deployment" or "Try deploying again". also maybe offer an inline "View logs" link.
Sophia L.: accessibility note: banner uses a pale yellow bg and mid-grey text — contrast looks low. we should run WCAG AA check. also need an aria-live region for the banner so SR users hear it.
Maria K.: thinking of copy + structure: heading: "Deployment failed" body: "We couldn't deploy your model right now. You can retry or check logs to troubleshoot." primary: "Retry deployment" secondary: "View logs". aria-label: "Deployment failed — retry deployment or view logs". any pushback on tone/length?
Tyler S.: I like explicit CTAs. prefer "Retry deployment" (short) over "Try deploying again". also recommend the order: primary = Retry, secondary = View logs. QA: ensure Retry triggers the same idempotent flow as the original deploy.
DesignBot: contrast-check: background #FFF7E6, text #6B4A00 => ratio 3.0:1 (fails AA for normal text). recommended fixes: darken text to #4A2E00 or shift bg to #F1E1C8.
Sophia L.: once contrast adjusted we should also ensure focus styles are visible (not just outline: none). keyboard order test: focus should land on primary (Retry) then secondary (View logs). screen reader: add role=alert and aria-live=assertive for immediate notice.
Maria K.: revised shorter body: "We couldn't deploy your model right now." keeps it concise. final proposed copy: heading "Deployment failed" body "We couldn't deploy your model right now." primary "Retry deployment" secondary "View logs" aria-label "Deployment failed — retry deployment or view logs". I'll update the Figma and the ticket.
Tyler S.: sounds good. I'll update the banner component and add contrast token adjustments, plus aria attributes. will open PR and tag you. :thumbsup:
Maria K.: thanks — assigning follow-up to @Tyler S. and adding an a11y checklist item.
Sophia L.: thanks all — will re-run automated a11y tests after the PR and sign off on contrast.
Maria K.: appreciate the quick feedback!
